days.universe: Latest saved supported pregame snapshot per fixture; 3 fixtures. Full supported universes recorded.

scorecard.interpretation: Primary daily view prefers the latest saved full supported-offer pregame snapshot for each fixture, preserving earlier-game records when later snapshots show only another game. Filters and timestamp are preserved. Other snapshots are appendices, not extra bets. One illustrative unit per acted selection at its recorded odds; pushes count as action with zero profit, voids have zero action, pending/review/invalid are excluded from returns and never losses. Editable browser research is not authenticated issuance or account settlement. Same-game picks and alternate lines are correlated. No combined-parlay EV.
